script:
N=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/events/count" --field .)
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/run" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized --save F05.control-errors/run-no-key
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/pause" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized --save F05.control-errors/pause-no-key
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/interrupt" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized --save F05.control-errors/interrupt-no-key
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/run" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/pause" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/interrupt" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/run --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains conversation_id --save F05.control-errors/run-malformed
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/pause --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains conversation_id
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/interrupt --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains conversation_id
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q" --check execution_status eq idle --save F05.control-errors/untouched
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/events/count" --check . eq "$N"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$Q/events/count" --query kind=$PAUSE_KIND --check . eq 0
